headword: {会席料理|かいせきりょうり}
gloss: kaiseki cuisine; traditional Japanese multi-course banquet meal

definitions.gloss: kaiseki cuisine; traditional Japanese multi-course banquet meal
definitions.explanation: A formal style of Japanese dining featuring multiple courses served in a set order, typically at banquets, receptions, and traditional restaurants. Courses usually include appetizers, sashimi, grilled dish, simmered dish, rice, and soup.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{会席|かいせき}→会席：11648_kaiseki⟧ (banquet, gathering seat) and ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (cuisine). Originally developed for gatherings where sake was enjoyed, with dishes designed to accompany drinking. Not to be confused with {懐石料理|かいせきりょうり} (tea ceremony cuisine), which uses different kanji and originates from the tea ceremony tradition with a focus on simplicity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会席料理|かいせきりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頂|いただ}く: to partake of a kaiseki meal
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{会席料理|かいせきりょうり}: seasonal kaiseki cuisine
- ⟦{和風|わふう}→和風：12034_wafuu⟧{会席料理|かいせきりょうり}: Japanese-style kaiseki
- {会席料理|かいせきりょうり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧: a kaiseki course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {懐石料理|かいせきりょうり}: tea ceremony cuisine — same pronunciation but different kanji; simpler, lighter meals rooted in tea ceremony aesthetics
- ⟦{割烹|かっぽう}→割烹：11922_kappou⟧: Japanese haute cuisine, cooking — refers to the cooking style or a restaurant serving high-end Japanese food
- ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧: traditional Japanese restaurant — the type of establishment where kaiseki is often served
